issue_request: Applied/Persuasive with Modification OO R6 issue asking that DocumentReference.basedOn stop describing a procedure and instead describe the activity that caused the document/media to be created.
initial_application: Jira linked HL7/fhir#4038, and commit 34b17c9393 changed source/documentreference/structuredefinition-DocumentReference.xml from procedure/procedure wording to Activity/activity wording while initially retaining media.
additional_context: FHIR-54167 is the same element family and intentionally refined the remaining media wording to document. Current source/fhir.ini keeps DocumentReference active and approved; current StructureDefinition and Event mapping exception use activity/document wording. The only stale current match is a generated-looking SVG tooltip, which is not a safe standalone source edit under the run guardrails.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The authoritative StructureDefinition already says 'Activity that caused this document to be created' and 'An activity that is fulfilled in whole or in part by the creation of this document.', which satisfies FHIR-54536 when read with the later FHIR-54167 refinement.

related_jiras.note: Same DocumentReference.basedOn wording family; explains why the final current text says document instead of retaining FHIR-54536's intermediate media wording.
